items.name: Dedicated solar-row cleaner
items.permitted_scope: Dry removal of compatible loose deposits on prepared rows.
items.unavailable_scope: One generic robot serving arbitrary array geometry; removal of permanent damage.
items.prerequisites: Named cleaner/module/tracker combination; parking, bridges, clearances, approved operating weather.
items.support: Per-row docks, communications, brushes, inspection, retrieval and vendor maintenance.
items.current_model: Section optical treatment exists; generic 1,000 m²/h and bus-fed charger are not T4 parameters.

items.name: Portable wet/dry cleaner
items.unavailable_scope: Unattended deployment or operation inferred from remote control.
items.prerequisites: Access, lifting/transport, module limits, water method, operator availability.
items.support: Travel, setup, water/refill, battery charging, consumables, return journey.
items.current_model: Portable wet service/logistics implemented as illustrative bundle.

items.name: Mobile ground inspector
items.permitted_scope: Commissioned visual/thermal/acoustic/gas observations with appropriate payload.
items.unavailable_scope: Repair, unqualified hydrogen-area access, or universal fault localization.
items.prerequisites: Route, lighting, terrain, stairs, reachable view/port and gas-group/payload certificate.
items.support: Dock, mapping, connectivity, remote assistance, retrieval, batteries and vendor service.
items.current_model: Mobile prepared-contact reader exists; not a realistic visual/thermal inspection model.

items.name: Docked aerial inspector
items.unavailable_scope: General manipulation, concealed-fault diagnosis or permission implied by autonomy.
items.prerequisites: Flight authorization, site airspace, landing margin, weather and inspection conditions.
items.support: Dock mains/backup, internet, aircraft maintenance, remote pilot responsibilities and retrieval.
items.current_model: Catalogue concept; no complete flight/payload mechanism reviewed.

items.name: Contact inspection crawler
items.unavailable_scope: Repair or automatic launch on every process surface.
items.prerequisites: Reachable material, coupling/contact, geometry and a thickness/degradation hypothesis.
items.support: Preparation, qualified interpretation, deployment/retrieval, sensor maintenance.
items.current_model: No corresponding wall-integrity process in current plant.

items.name: Vegetation-management robot
items.permitted_scope: Mapped vegetation cutting on suitable ground.
items.unavailable_scope: Universal terrain operation or value without vegetation/access mechanics.
items.prerequisites: Terrain/obstacles, exclusion rules, growth and shading/access effects.
items.support: Charging pod, Mission Control, blade service, weather and recovery.

items.name: Sampling and analyzer station
items.permitted_scope: Switch and condition compatible process/reference samples.
items.unavailable_scope: Complete chemical diagnosis or certification from a selector alone.
items.prerequisites: Analyzer, gas compatibility, flow/pressure conditioning, transport/purge delays.
items.support: Reference gases, filters, utilities, calibration, purge/sample accounting.

items.name: Automatic sensor service station
items.permitted_scope: Clean/calibrate a compatible pH/ORP sensor using the specified station.
items.prerequisites: Matching sensor, references, retractable assembly and permitted environment.
items.support: Reagents, reference replacement, waste, pneumatics and technician service.
items.current_model: Generic calibration remedy lacks identified H2 metrology procedure.

items.name: Rugged fixed sensor package
items.permitted_scope: Named electrical/process/material measurements with bounded error.
items.unavailable_scope: Perfect inventory, exact loose/adhered fractions or generic remaining-life truth.
items.prerequisites: Measurement model, range, placement, references and channel independence.
items.support: Calibration, drift checks, protection, power/comms and replacement.
items.current_model: Fixed contact/reference acquisition exists; other ideal plant observations remain.

items.name: Remote actuator / redundant service path
items.permitted_scope: Command and verify a specified permitted action after cause clearance.
items.unavailable_scope: Reset repairing physical damage; bypass of unresolved trips.
items.prerequisites: OEM semantics, permissives, position/process feedback, power and communication.
items.support: Actuator maintenance, stored-energy provision where required, testing and fallback.
items.current_model: Latched trip reset exists; only an illustrative engineered interface.

items.name: Mobile maintenance manipulator
items.unavailable_scope: Credible default autonomous electrolyser repair or consumable exchange.
items.prerequisites: Reach, tool, torque, connectors, isolation and acceptance specification.
items.support: Tooling, fixtures, remote supervision, parts and recovery.
items.current_model: Future capability; do not substitute rover inspection for manipulation.

items.name: Robot-compatible replaceable module
items.unavailable_scope: Qualified hydrogen module replacement inferred from a water-filter lab demo.
items.prerequisites: Guides/connectors, depressurization/isolation, lifting, seals and proof tests.
items.support: Spare compatibility, handling, waste, tools and trained fallback.
items.current_model: Current human module replacement is generic; robotic replacement not established.

items.name: Solar construction robot
items.permitted_scope: Construction-phase installation assistance on compatible designs.
items.unavailable_scope: Ongoing maintenance autonomy or whole-site commissioning from panel placement alone.
items.prerequisites: Foundation/tracker readiness, logistics, quality acceptance and crew workflow.
items.support: Mobilization, transport, rented equipment, operators and commissioning.
items.current_model: Separate build-phase scenario; not daily service comparison.

items.name: Pre-integrated deployable solar array
items.prerequisites: Ground preparation, access, footprint, wind design and compatible cleaning.
items.support: Transport, crew, telehandler, electrical commissioning and O&M access.
